description_for_human: Turn any website URL into a prompt for recreating its UI.
description_for_model: Given a public website URL, returns a detailed design brief (layout, components, colors, typography, spacing) for recreating that UI with a code model. Use when the user wants to clone or copy the design of an existing site. Output is a text prompt, not code. Costs $0.25 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE).
